span.p: Runs on BOTH branches, outside the if — touchUpdateAudit stamps updatedAt and updatedBy, then projectRepository.save. The project row is written even when the flag did not change

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: toResponse of the saved project is built here, before any cascade — the bulk UPDATE runs with clearAutomatically true and detaches the entity

span.p: visibilityChanged AND safeTrim of visibilityCascade equalsIgnoreCase CASCADE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: NONE, omitted, or no change — every child isPublic is preserved so admins keep per-media overrides, and no media cache is evicted

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: updateVisibilityByProject once each on audioRepository, videoRepository, imageRepository, textRepository. Per table: SET isPublic, updatedAt, updatedBy, version COALESCE plus 1 WHERE project matches AND removedAt IS NULL AND isPublic IS NULL or differs — trashed and already-matching rows are skipped

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Per-type ReadCache.evictAll fires only where that repository returned a count above zero — a cascade that changed nothing evicts nothing

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Always: ProjectReadCache.evictAll clears projects:all plus the tag and keyword suggest caches, then one ProjectAuditAction.UPDATE row spelling out the four cascade counts

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: GuestSearchService.isPubliclyVisible — media removedAt null AND isPublic not FALSE AND project removedAt null AND project isVisibleToPublic not FALSE

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Guest sees the row — a null flag counts as visible at both levels

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Guest sees nothing. A public project with a private child still hides that child, and a hidden project hides every child no matter how public each one is

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: GET /api/items still lists every active row — isPublic and projectVisibleToPublic are only optional filters. But it reads the four media caches, and each cached DTO snapshots projectVisibleToPublic, so a cache left un-evicted above serves a stale project flag
